Class SpaceObject

java.lang.Object
SpaceObject
Direct Known Subclasses:
Debris, Payload, RocketBody, Satellite, UnknownObject
public class SpaceObject extends Object
The SpaceObject class represents a generic object in space, such as a satellite, debris, or rocket body. It contains common attributes and methods shared by all space objects.

This class serves as a base class for more specific types of space objects, such as Debris, RocketBody, and Payload.

  • Constructor Details

    • SpaceObject

      public SpaceObject(String recordId, String satelliteName, String country, String orbitType, int launchYear, String launchSite, double longitude, double avgLongitude, String geohash, int daysOld, int conjunctionCount)
      Constructs a SpaceObject with the specified attributes.
      Parameters:
      recordId - the unique record ID of the space object
      satelliteName - the name of the satellite or object
      country - the country associated with the space object
      orbitType - the type of orbit (e.g., LEO, GEO)
      launchYear - the year the object was launched
      launchSite - the site where the object was launched
      longitude - the current longitude of the object
      avgLongitude - the average longitude of the object
      geohash - the geohash representing the object's location
      daysOld - the number of days since the object was launched
      conjunctionCount - the number of conjunction events associated with the object
